description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade and configuration functions for embedded devices, primarily related to flashing firmware, copying configurations, and managing disk partitions in an OpenWrt-based environment.

methods.name: platform_get_rootfs
methods.description: Determines the root filesystem device by parsing kernel command line.

methods.name: platform_get_n821_disk
methods.description: Returns the device path for the N821 disk based on platform device files.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_helper
methods.description: Copies backup configuration to the device.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies platform-specific configuration based on device type.

methods.name: platform_do_flash
methods.description: Performs the flashing of kernel and root filesystem from a tar file.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main entry point to upgrade the device firmware, calls platform_do_flash.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates upgrade image integrity for supported boards.
